title: Cargo Door Surround Sill Fitting — Fretting and Hole Elongation Repair
abstract: Permanent repair for fretting and fastener hole elongation at the cargo door surround sill fitting, using oversize fasteners and a bushed insert where the elongation exceeds the first oversize.

sections.purpose: To give the permanent repair for fretting damage and fastener hole elongation found at the cargo door surround sill fitting.
sections.damage_assessment: Fretting at the sill fitting is driven by door cycling and shows first as a red-brown deposit at the faying face and later as elongation of the fastener holes on the door side of the joint. Assess the damage with the fitting exposed and the fasteners removed. Measure each hole in two directions at right angles and record the larger dimension. Record the number of door cycles since delivery or since the last repair at this location, because the repair interval is driven by cycles rather than by flight hours. A fitting with more than four elongated holes in one group is outside this scheme and must be replaced. Examine the mating land on the surround structure at the same time; fretting is always a two-sided finding and repairing only one side will return the damage quickly.
sections.repair_procedure: Open the cargo door and support it. Remove the lining and get access to the sill fitting from inside. Remove the fasteners from the affected group, keeping them in order. Clean both faying faces and remove the fretting product with a non-metallic abrasive. Measure every hole in two directions and mark the elongated ones. Ream each elongated hole to the first oversize using the reamer in the tooling list, holding the drill perpendicular with the guide. Where the elongation exceeds the first oversize, ream to the second oversize and install a bushed insert to the drawing, bonded with the adhesive listed. Do an eddy current inspection at every reamed hole. Apply the surface treatment to both faying faces within the application window. Install the doubler D5230129687429 where the drawing requires it and the plate D5230135108629 at the aft end of the group. Install the fasteners EN989730K5 wet with sealant, torquing in the sequence on the drawing so that the joint pulls up evenly. Apply the sealing bead at the joint edge. Do the door rigging check and confirm that the closing forces are inside the band.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do an eddy current inspection at every reamed hole at completion and record the baseline. Do a detailed visual inspection of the faying face at every 3 000 door cycles or at every heavy check, whichever comes first, and record the number of door cycles at each inspection. Re-elongation at a bushed hole invalidates the repair and the fitting must be replaced.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Up to four elongated holes per fastener group, each with elongation not exceeding the second oversize diameter, and no elongation at a hole within 20 mm of the fitting free edge.

repair_drawings.title: Oversize and bushed insert scheme, cargo door surround sill fitting

type_data.fastener_pattern: Existing pattern retained at the first or second oversize as required, 18 fasteners in the affected group, torqued in the sequence on the drawing.
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life-limited to 12 000 door cycles with a detailed visual inspection of the faying face every 3 000 door cycles. Re-elongation at a bushed hole requires fitting replacement.
